items.title: The Hawks officially waived Devin Carter.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
The Hawks officially waived Devin Carter.

Atlanta has a well-documented roster crunch and still has 16 for 15 spots even after waiving Carter.

In June, the Hawks received a 2033 second round pick from SAC to take Carter’s ~$5.1M contract.

Atlanta also waived Lamont Butler today.

items.title: Fucking hell. This was a great, thriving sports section once upon a time -- and a huge influence on young me, as a college student/aspiring journalist back in the '80s.
items.author: Howard Beck
items.body_excerpt:
Fucking hell. This was a great, thriving sports section once upon a time -- and a huge influence on young me, as a college student/aspiring journalist back in the '80s.

I've said it for years, and it remains true: Journalism hasn't failed. The geniuses who ran the business side failed all of us.
